item.title: Research
item.description:
Research Interests

I study how linguistic knowledge emerges and is represented in biological and artificial systems using computational models.

Current Projects

Language Learning in Artificial Systems

Can linguistic structure emerge from speech recognition learning?

Understanding Language Models

How do artificial neural systems represent and process speech and language?
